detail.body:
## Motivation

Add bounded native KV offload for Ascend DSA serving with LIM selection and full-visible CopySFA attention. This follow-up removes unnecessary resident-staging work from long requests without changing the existing Host KV publication or CopySFA resident-refresh path.

## Changes

- Replace history address/mask materialization followed by a generic copy with a native short-history restore operator. Long rows skip the history-position loop using the actual device lengths.
- Fuse current-KV destination calculation, resident-cache writes, and extent commits into one Triton kernel. Historical restoration reads immutable old extents and writes separate next extents before current-KV processing.
- Keep the target's bounded resident-cache policy and the draft worker's native KV policy. Preserve short, long, mixed, padding, request-reuse, and graph-replay behavior.
- Expose the native restore through the lazy `sglang.kernels.ops.kvcache` namespace and add a reproducible manual staging A/B benchmark.

The native operator is supplied by the companion [sgl-kernel-npu PR #909](https://github.com/sgl-project/sgl-kernel-npu/pull/909). The candidate requires a wheel containing `npu::restore_short_kv_history`.

## Validation

- Complete A3 wheel build: exit 0. Native graph/bounds validation: 1 passed. Framework staging validation: 18 passed, covering Q=1/2/3/4/5/8/14 in eager/graph mode, request reuse, physical mapping changes, C-1/C/C+1, invalid indices, padding, and feature tails.
- KV payload and extent checks use independent expected values and exact comparisons (`atol=0`, `rtol=0` or `torch.equal`). These are staging numerical checks, not model-task accuracy results.
- Staging A/B: B16, Q4, C12288, BF16, 576 features, context limit 67584. Both implementations used the same candidate wheel and deterministic input in the same process. Each side used 10 warmups and 30 timed samples. All eight eager/graph cases matched numerically and had lower median latency.
- Long-request staging, int32/first stride 1: eager 554.81 -> 143.67 us; graph 492.55 -> 66.45 us.
- Separate long-request follow-up with int64 metadata and `positions[B,Q][:,0]` first-position stride 4: eager 557.97 -> 160.69 us; graph 487.14 -> 61.95 us. Both cases matched the independent oracle and baseline exactly, exit 0.
- Publication checks include Ruff, Ruff formatting, isort, syntax/whitespace checks, and isolated lazy-registry/argument-forwarding smoke validation. The complete namespace suite was not run in the Windows host environment.

The NPU results were collected on the frozen core implementation before adding the thin in-tree facade and the portable benchmark CLI; the numerical kernel bodies are unchanged. Native NPU tests were run explicitly on A3 rather than inferred from generic PR CI.

## Reproduce the staging benchmark

With the companion kernel wheel installed, place the candidate framework's `python` directory first in `PYTHONPATH`, preserving the existing value. Run `test/manual/kernels/bench_npu_resident_staging.py` with `--baseline` and `--candidate` pointing to the two `npu_kv_residency.py` files, and an `--output` JSON path. Use `--layout int32-stride1` for all eight cases or `--layout int64-stride4` for the long-request follow-up. Redirect stdout/stderr to a persistent log.

The measurements cover `stage_resident_kv`; the required Host KV publication is outside that timed subchain. End-to-end TPOT, serving throughput, and model-task accuracy have not been measured for this update. Analytical TPOT estimates are not presented as benchmark results.

@@ -0,0 +1,98 @@
+LIM / GLM-5.2 W4A8 / 217 精度报告，整理日期2026-10-22
+
+结论：最新32题自定义长提示任务得分为全HBM29/32、LI reference29/32、原生LIM30/32，未观察到本组答对数下降。
+同策略LI reference→LIM仍有非零logits分布差异；32K边界组mean KL=0.13769843、p99=4.51716358，尚未建立数值等价或通用质量无损结论。
+性能报告的random/random-ids是负载生成方式；这里的答题质量使用GSM8K自定义子集，边界数值诊断使用固定retrieval提示。不同数据来源分别标记。
+
+模型与术语
+测试机217，GLM-5.2-w4a8，16 Ascend A3 die，TP16/EP16，DeepEP auto；W4A8权重，主KV/index KV均BF16。
+全HBM原始LI：主KV与index KV全部在设备HBM，原始npu_lightning_indexer在整个可见序列选TopK；attention仍是稀疏attention。
+LI reference：Host保存全量主KV、HBM保留resident cache；原始LI选prefix TopK，并追加完整visible tail。
+原生LIM：采用相同prefix+tail策略，原生fused_lightning_indexer_manage计算索引及缓存计划；copy与SFA仍是独立操作。
+K=2048是选取的TopK个数；C=2048/4096是每请求每层主KV的HBM resident token容量；index KV仍在HBM。
+当前Q1卸载路径最多追加128个tail token，选取范围与原始全可见序列TopK不同。C还参与进入卸载路径的阈值。
+标准kernel实现b5a45667efb377b0312108c01bbd0a730c1f9e78；正常库SHA256 ff93127d1294ef50b848816ba4710d44ef950ad54e4dc6498e88f4805be827a8。
+
+A. 最新统一runtime验证：2026-10-22/runtime8961cc3689aa9ba4f476ee133f29fb43eb5dc51c
+TP16/EP16、graph16、max-running-requests16、ctx36864、token pool147456、page128、unchunked prefill、radix关闭、seed42、MTP关闭、K2048/C4096。
+所有正式capture/自由答题窗口均通过有前后覆盖的NPU进程扫描核验；不采纳其他NPU任务干扰的首份baseline-main-a1。
+
+| case | 输入/输出 | 客户端并发 | 每模式份数 | 用途 |
+| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
+| GSM8K自由答题 | 6507–6589输入；自然停止，最多512输出 | 4 | 1 | 32题40-shot自定义子集 |
+| 固定历史主测试 | 相同32题输入；每条512预测位置 | 16 | 2 | 首轮+重复，比较完整词表logits |
+| 32K边界数值诊断 | 32767/32768/32895/32896输入；每条128位置 | 1 | 1 | 原生chat retrieval提示的块边界检查 |
+
+| 路径 | C | 答对/总数 | 答对率 | 触及512上限 |
+| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
+| 全HBM原始LI | — | 29/32 | 90.625% | 0 |
+| LI reference | 4096 | 29/32 | 90.625% | 0 |
+| 原生LIM | 4096 | 30/32 | 93.750% | 0 |
+
+本组不是标准GSM8K榜单评测，32题不足以建立精度提升或总体质量等价。Decimal归一化后分数不变。
+基线和LI reference错题为gsm8k-12/13/15；LIM错题为12/13。第15题gold=125，三路径分别回答29/96/125。
+
+B. 主测试完整词表KL：每行16384个相同历史位置
+KL方向为p_reference || p_candidate，CPU float64。先保存未改动的完整词表logits，再force相同continuation IDs；不使用force后的API logprob冒充原始概率。
+固定历史采满512位置并ignore_eos，包含自由答题自然停止后的延续；它是数值诊断，与自由生成得分分别报告。
+
+| reference → candidate | mean KL | p99 KL | max KL | Top1一致率 | 整向量逐位一致位置比例 |
+| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
+| 全HBM-main-a2 → 全HBM-repeat-a1 | 0.00842651 | 0.17121563 | 1.61088135 | 98.279% | 18.750% |
+| LI reference-main-a1 → LI reference-repeat-a1 | 0.00671625 | 0.14758153 | 1.98562673 | 98.517% | 40.625% |
+| 全HBM-main-a2 → LI reference-main-a1 | 0.01011665 | 0.18067442 | 2.01791404 | 97.742% | 0.043% |
+| 原生LIM-main-a1 → 原生LIM-repeat-a1 | 0.01036212 | 0.18240875 | 1.78293569 | 97.821% | 1.483% |
+| 全HBM-main-a2 → 原生LIM-main-a1 | 0.01050684 | 0.18644351 | 1.56977138 | 97.729% | 0.061% |
+| LI reference-main-a1 → 原生LIM-main-a1 | 0.01028256 | 0.18419464 | 2.18401910 | 97.797% | 0.061% |
+
+同模式重复已经非零；不能用一次跨模式KL直接归因到缓存错误，也不能把两个KL相减得到“LIM净误差”。
+全HBM重复有26条、LI reference重复有19条从prefill step0开始不同；分别有6/13条完整512位置逐位相同。
+LIM重复18条从step0开始不同；其余14条prefill最后输出相同，但12条在step3、1条在step87、1条在step120出现差异，完整512位置逐位相同为0/32。
+因此，LIM差异不能全部归为prefill最后输出波动；最后logits相同也不保证各层KV状态相同。
+
+C. 32K边界组：每行4×128=512个位置
+
+| reference → candidate | mean KL | p99 KL | max KL | Top1一致率 |
+| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
+| 全HBM-boundary-a1 → LI reference-boundary-a1 | 0.06806639 | 1.39569787 | 9.38738671 | 97.4609% |
+| 全HBM-boundary-a1 → 原生LIM-boundary-a1 | 0.13789043 | 4.55565362 | 9.91980816 | 95.1172% |
+| LI reference-boundary-a1 → 原生LIM-boundary-a1 | 0.13769843 | 4.51716358 | 9.33487506 | 95.3125% |
+
+| 同策略输入长度 | mean KL | p99 KL | max KL | Top1一致率 |
+| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
+| 32767 | 0.18452188 | 7.31148857 | 9.33487506 | 93.7500% |
+| 32768 | 0.03125171 | 0.27885463 | 0.64188897 | 96.0938% |
+| 32895 | 0.30701157 | 6.47040211 | 8.22495165 | 92.9688% |
+| 32896 | 0.02800853 | 0.34555637 | 1.66044253 | 98.4375% |
+
+同策略四条边界输入的prefill最后输出logits全部逐位相同，均从第一个decode位置开始非逐位相同。
+首次decode差异很小：mean KL 2.63327957e-07、max 4.99423865e-07、Top1一致率100%；较大差异出现在后续位置。
+边界组未做同模式重复；不能套用6.5K主测试的重复差异作32K噪声基线。未将这些数值直接定性为KV搬错或页边界bug。
+
+D. C2048/C4096历史补充：2026-10-21/runtime611760f1
+以下是旧runtime下同一32题自定义长提示任务的历史单轮分数，独立保留，不与上面新runtime结果合并。
+
+| 历史路径 | C | 答对/总数 | 触及512上限 |
+| --- | --- | --- | --- |
+| 全HBM原始LI | — | 30/32 | 0 |
+| LI reference | 4096 | 28/32 | 0 |
+| 原生LIM | 4096 | 30/32 | 0 |
+| 原生LIM | 2048 | 28/32 | 0 |
+
+历史reference→LIM C4096/C2048 mean KL分别为0.00961504/0.01028223；reference自身重复0.00613559。没有本轮统一runtime的C2048复测。
+C不改变K；这些长输入都进入卸载路径，但阈值附近改变C可能改变路径/选择策略，不能泛称跨C质量等价。
+
+E. 精度结论与尚未完成的定位
+已证实：本组任务得分未下降；最新99,840份有效完整词表向量的输入/输出历史及步号已逐项核验，所有原始张量已逐文件SHA256校验归档。
+未建立：LIM与同策略参考的端到端数值等价、标准完整GSM8K或代码/长上下文任务质量等价。64K有独占性能数据，但此前64K精度诊断含外部AFS占用扫描，不纳入本报告正式精度结论。
+下一定位入口：固定同层Q/K/weights输入，对比TopK集合与排序、逐位核对selected KV，再比较SFA输入/输出；覆盖新页进入、miss回填、padding和请求复用。
+本轮没有捕获真实模型上述中间张量oracle，不能确定当前差异来自TopK数值、KV路由、搬运或SFA中的哪一项。
+当前覆盖BF16主KV/index KV、Q1、无MTP；C8、MTP及完整random性能矩阵不在已验证结果内。
+
+来源与证据
+完整最新报告：LIM_PRECISION_217_RESULTS.txt，含逐题答案、实际processor行数、同prefill子集和每位置明细位置。
+历史补充：LIM_NATIVE_217_RESULTS.txt；性能：LIM_PERFORMANCE_217_REPORT.txt。
+最新precision-summary.json SHA256 e53e4948ea3228db113b904acd2e7d5e180c9b0cc822125bc2d71bf4a4561151
+compact证据：lim-precision-217-evidence-20261022.tar.gz，19525441 bytes，SHA256 8cd2fc12d835cf5024938c70f60ff3db28317745e28a6baa93b9f58c0b43a75e。
+本地已校验compact全部659文件哈希，并从逐位置KL记录复算9组标量汇总，差值全部为0；完整原始词表KL在217计算，未声称在本机全量重算。
+完整raw logits与逐张量清单保留于217：/home/y00970600/personal/hisparse-lim-precision-217-20261022/archives/及results/。

@@ -0,0 +1,224 @@
+217 / GLM-5.2 W4A8 / LIM 文章对照与实测，2026-10-22
+
+最新三路径精度复测见 LIM_PRECISION_217_RESULTS.txt：32题自由生成、32×512完整词表与重复对照、32K边界组。
+该精度复测采用独立配置；本文件中的profile和性能数据仍对应下述原始配置。
+
+本轮按用户提供的《decode KVcache 低时延卸载技术实践》重新采集三组对照；
+输入为固定 token-ID retrieval 提示，输出512 token、ignore_eos，不是 SWE-bench。
+现有实现是原生 LIM 管理元数据 + 独立 copy + 独立 SFA。CopySFA、SharedCopy、
+C8、MTP 尚未接入本轮实现，不能把文章中的性能或精度无损结论直接移用。
+
+版本与配置
+基线 runtime: 611760f18007a63781f42c666fe9a296e96b6fa8
+LIM runtime: 8961cc3689aa9ba4f476ee133f29fb43eb5dc51c
+社区 main 基点: 4b83f215f498bc0371587bfae4a9470f24e77737；本轮固定版本，不在测量中换 main。
+kernel 实现 b5a45667efb377b0312108c01bbd0a730c1f9e78，发布分支头6d830514。
+标准 sgl-kernel-npu wheel SHA256: 7606b7493725ffe70cd5eb70ac1b52b46ef4223efb3e41fa91252dd15cb0a22b
+加载的正常库 SHA256: ff93127d1294ef50b848816ba4710d44ef950ad54e4dc6498e88f4805be827a8
+16 Ascend A3 die，TP16/EP16，DeepEP auto，W4A8权重，主KV和index KV均BF16。
+ctx66048，max-running-requests16，page128，chunked-prefill4096，mem-fraction-static0.82，
+radix禁用，graph capture batch16，seed42，MTP关闭。K=2048，C=4096。
+K 是每次索引选取的 TopK 数；C 是每请求每层主KV的HBM resident token容量。
+基线实际token pool204800；LIM长大batch实际index pool859136（请求1048576后被clamp）。
+精度专用LIM实例将实际index pool设204800，以对齐基线容量；内核与策略不变。
+三组正式profile均采10个完整decode图、16 rank全部验证；计时来自另行运行的无profiler请求。
+
+独立性能：每组两轮，不丢弃慢轮，不宣称最大吞吐
+| 场景 | 轮次 | 满batch decode TPS | 有效TPOT ms | SSE间隔中位 ms | 整批耗时含prefill s | 整批output TPS | HBM峰值中位 MiB | 最坏芯片 MiB |
+|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
+| 全HBM 16K/B12 | 1 | 219.404 | 54.694 | 54.655 | 117.430 | 52.321 | 59961.0 | 60159 |
+| 全HBM 16K/B12 | 2 | 217.802 | 55.096 | 55.057 | 116.226 | 52.863 | 59961.0 | 60159 |
+| 全HBM 64K/B3 | 1 | 59.157 | 50.712 | 50.680 | 126.518 | 12.141 | 59961.0 | 60159 |
+| 全HBM 64K/B3 | 2 | 59.074 | 50.784 | 50.728 | 126.403 | 12.152 | 59961.0 | 60159 |
+| LIM 64K/B12 | 1 | 73.450 | 163.377 | 163.482 | 672.310 | 9.139 | 59993.5 | 60521 |
+| LIM 64K/B12 | 2 | 74.167 | 161.796 | 161.717 | 656.930 | 9.353 | 59993.5 | 60522 |
+同64K输入的这两个可容纳配置，LIM把实际并发3提升至12，decode TPS中位数 59.116→73.809，变化+24.85%；
+有效TPOT 50.748→162.587 ms，变化+220.38%。收益须结合单请求SLO判断。
+该对比是固定内存预算下不同可容纳batch的系统收益，不是同batch算子加速比。
+有效TPOT=1000×实际batch/decode TPS；SSE间隔受客户端调度影响，两个值分别保存。
+窗口在所有请求至少输出10 token后开始、首请求结束前截止，排除prefill和drain。未使用ITL/3。
+整批耗时包括prefill与首填充，独立列出，不能由decode TPS推断TTFT或完整请求收益。
+LIM第一轮prefill与本任务CPU trace分析重叠，整批耗时仅作诊断；第二轮整批无此重叠。
+无上述CPU重叠的整批对比：全HBM output TPS中位12.146，LIM第二轮9.353，变化-23.00%。
+该整批结果与稳定decode收益分别判断；LIM只有一轮整批无CPU重叠，不足以建立整请求性能分布。
+所有六个decode计时窗口均无本任务CPU分析/测试重叠，NPU占用扫描均覆盖窗口且无外部模型干扰。

+理论上12×64000 token、78层BF16主KV本身约64.27GiB/rank，尚未计权重/index/graph；
+C4096的17个resident行主KV约5.827GiB/rank，另计selected/tail等workspace，省出的预算被用于扩大index pool。
+基线与LIM均固定graph16，没有搜索更适合B3的graph4或最优饱和batch，不把B3称为硬件最大并发。

+Ascend LIM profiling and independent decode timing
+================================================
+
+Run profile_lim_model.py in the server's filesystem namespace, with a shared
+writable results directory. The profiler output_dir is a server-side path.
+Use the normal sgl-kernel-npu wheel containing the native LIM operator.
+This client does not install operators, launch servers, or stop other jobs.
+
+Prepare frozen native-chat token-ID inputs once and reuse the same file across
+all modes. Input length, output length, batch, capture steps and warmup are
+configurable. Existing fixtures and capture tags are never overwritten.
+Use --disable-radix-cache, allow enough context for input plus output, and check
+the actual token-pool capacity. Keep graphs enabled for formal captures. Raw
+logit and miss diagnostics also require --enable-custom-logit-processor.
+
+  python profile_lim_model.py prepare --model /models/GLM-5.2-w4a8 \
+    --fixtures /task/results/profile-fixtures.json \
+    --input-lengths 512 8192 16000 64000 --variants 16
+
+After each server is healthy, run the smoke check. This is a retrieval smoke
+test, not a general accuracy benchmark or a full-vocabulary precision check.
+When switching servers, also wait for every former worker to disappear and for
+all device HBM watermarks to return to their idle range. Process exit can precede
+device memory release; starting immediately can trip the TP memory-balance guard.
+
+  python profile_lim_model.py smoke --url http://127.0.0.1:30000 \
+    --fixtures /task/results/profile-fixtures.json --tag baseline-smoke
+
+Use three controls to separate storage capacity and batch computation:
+  1. Long context, smaller batch, original full-HBM storage.
+  2. Short context, larger batch, original full-HBM storage.
+  3. Same long context as (1), same larger batch as (2), LIM offload.
+
+Check the actual admitted token pool after startup. max-total-tokens is a
+requested upper limit and can be clamped. Do not call a queued/retracted batch
+a full-batch decode measurement. Choose capacities from the actual KV dtype;
+W4A8 model weights do not imply an 8-bit KV cache.
+
+For each separately configured server, select the matching length and batch:
+
+  python profile_lim_model.py capture --url http://127.0.0.1:30000 \
+    --workdir /task/results --fixtures /task/results/profile-fixtures.json \
+    --tag lim-64k-b12 --length 64000 --batch 12 --tokens 512 \
+    --warmup-tokens 10 --steps 10 --followup-rounds 2
+
+The client starts concurrent streaming requests, waits until every request has
+generated at least warmup-tokens, then arms CPU/NPU profiling. An early finish,
+HTTP failure, incomplete output, or missed barrier invalidates the capture.
+Cleanup aborts only the request IDs created by this client.
+
+Formal captures use graphs enabled, with_stack=False, record_shapes=False and
+detailed iteration annotations. Raw CANN ascend_pt directories, including
+PROF_* data and ASCEND_PROFILER_OUTPUT, remain under profiles/<tag>/decode.
+with-stack can be enabled separately for a source mapping capture. A graph-off
+mapping capture and a graph-on formal capture have different purposes.
+
+Profiled request latency is diagnostic. followup-rounds creates separate HTTP
+requests with profiling disabled. --no-profile performs just such a measurement.
+Streaming throughput is computed over the common active decode window after
+the full-batch barrier and before the first request ends. Prefill and batch
+drain are excluded. Output token counters supply the numerator; there is no
+assumption that a model step emits three tokens. Preserve individual repeats;
+two measured repeats do not establish a maximum-throughput or tail-latency claim.
+Keep full client batch elapsed time separately when considering request-level
+benefit. A faster stable decode window does not measure prefill, first fill or
+TTFT. Record concurrent CPU analysis and exclude it from any prefill timing claim.
+
+Analyze each rank independently, identified by its scheduler PID:
+
+  python analyze_lim_profile.py /path/ASCEND_PROFILER_OUTPUT/trace_view.json \
+    --output rank0-analysis.json --layers 78
+
+The analyzer preserves the raw trace hash, normalizes large decimal timestamps,
+reports cumulative time separately from interval unions, and accepts a graph
+replay window only when it contains the expected SFA layer count. Graph spans
+include other captured model work, such as the LM head; they are not a measured
+78-layer-only span or end-to-end ITL. HCCL task spans can contain waiting.
+
+Five-copy direction attribution applies only to the audited current BF16 LIM
+adapter and complete serial groups: new-token D2H, miss H2D to resident, resident
+to selected D2D, short-row H2D, tail H2D. A long row can still launch a masked
+short-row copy. Ambiguous groups are rejected rather than assigned directions.
+Never estimate cache hit rate or copied bytes from a copy kernel's duration.
+
+The current integration has LIM metadata fusion plus separate copy and SFA.
+CopySFA, grouped SharedCopy, C8 and framework MTP are separate capabilities.
+CopySFA hiding percentage requires matched split/fused inputs and cache states;
+it is unavailable when no fused implementation was measured.
+
+CPU diagnostic checks:
+  python test/manual/ascend/test_lim_profile_analysis.py -v
+  python test/registered/unit/hardware_backend/test_npu_sparse_host_callback.py -v
+
+For aligned raw-logit checks, use check_lim_decode_precision.py separately from
+timing. Capture untouched logits before forcing reference tokens, verify exact
+histories, and repeat both modes to quantify same-mode variability.
+For fixed chunked prefill, pass the actual --prefill-chunk-size and use
+--concurrency 1. Disable radix reuse, mixed chunks and dynamic chunking.
+Intermediate chunks can invoke the sampling processor even though their token
+is discarded. The helper skips ceil(input_length/chunk_size)-1 such calls,
+preserves untouched logits before forcing, and verifies raw-call indices against
+the HTTP output IDs. Do not use an unchunked capture helper on a chunked server.
+
+  python check_lim_decode_precision.py capture --fixtures boundary-inputs.json \
+    --tag lim-free --samples 4 --tokens 64 --concurrency 1 \
+    --prefill-chunk-size 4096 --workdir /task
+
+  python check_lim_decode_precision.py capture \
+    --fixtures /task/results/lim-free-teacher-fixtures.json \
+    --tag baseline-forced --force --samples 4 --tokens 64 --concurrency 1 \
+    --prefill-chunk-size 4096 --workdir /task
+
+For a separate last-owner miss-counter diagnostic (also excluded from timing):
+
+  python check_lim_last_owner_misses.py --url http://127.0.0.1:30000 \
+    --fixtures /task/results/profile-fixtures.json --case L64000-v0 \
+    --output /task/results/last-owner-misses.json --tokens 128 \
+    --prefill-chunk-size 4096
+
+The adapter reuses outputs across IndexShare owners. This request can observe
+only the final owner after a model forward. It excludes sampling step zero
+(prefill), checks cold copy_count=C versus query misses=K, and reports Q1 steady
+prefix misses with denominator K. It also records actual index-buffer geometry.
+Full-tail tokens and graph padding are excluded. This is not a 21-owner average
+or a workload-wide cache-hit estimate; collecting those needs per-owner counters.

+LIM / Copy-SFA chain-MTP validation on 217
+2026-10-26, Asia/Shanghai
+
+Branch: feat/hisparse-lim-copysfa-opt-217-mtp
+Base: 6e37ddf7d6a7228250b836cc1a3801ad7c876b81 (merged opt-217 including C4096/C8192 and DeepEP fixes).
+The original dirty checkout was preserved; this is a separate managed worktree.
+
+Supported scope
+EAGLE/NEXTN chain MTP (validated with spec v2), topk=1, PP=1, no DCP, Ascend DSA MLA, BF16,
+page size 128, model index_topk=2048. C2048/4096/8192 component checks pass.
+MTP uses the vendor causal indexer rather than the native Q1 LIM indexer plan.
+Long eager C2048 queries can use sequential Q1 Copy-SFA. MTP graphs and
+C4096/C8192 use selected-KV SFA. This is not a fused multi-query native kernel.
+Short/mixed decode batches retain the existing eager graph-eligibility guard.
+
+Fixes verified
+- Publish speculative KV at absolute positions; mask rejected extend columns.
+- Obtain query width from speculative metadata. TP token padding is a suffix,
+  not extra query columns: a 2x3 window padded to 8 must not overwrite position 0.
+- Pad missing indexer rows with -1 while preserving K, rather than reshaping K.
+- Pack short TopK destinations as a contiguous alias of existing KV scratch.
+- Compact invalid source IDs while preserving valid KV order and causality.
+  Exact FP32 ordinal keys avoid the reported integer ArgSort AiCPU fallback.
+- Invalidate stale residency for rewritten drafts; reset both managers on reuse.
+- Give the draft backend its own KV pool explicitly. EAGLE shares the target
+  allocator's token IDs, so allocator.get_kvcache() is not the draft's KV pool.
+  The previous two managers could alias the target host KV and misprice draft HBM.
+- Price target and draft managers, index-scale scratch, and eager TP padding
+  consistently before admitting requests. Draft backends share one draft manager.
+
+Verification

+Purpose and configuration
+-------------------------
+Integrate the FusedLightningIndexerManage (LIM) operator into the
+SGLang DSA NPU decode path. Full compact attention KV remains in registered
+host DRAM; each request/layer retains C tokens of main KV in HBM. Full indexer
+keys remain in HBM. K is the selected TopK count, fixed at 2048; C is the
+resident capacity and does not increase TopK.

+The default remains legacy. Experimental modes are explicit:
+  SGLANG_NPU_ENABLE_SPARSE_KV_OFFLOAD=1
+  SGLANG_NPU_SPARSE_KV_INDEXER=legacy|lim
+  SGLANG_NPU_SPARSE_KV_CACHE_SIZE=4096
+
+The optional LI reference implementation has been removed. Historical LI reference
+measurements below are retained as archived results only.

+Alternatively set CACHE_SIZE=0 and SGLANG_NPU_SPARSE_KV_HBM_BUDGET_MB to derive C.

+and selected/adapter workspaces. Model weights, full indexer KV, allocator
+fragmentation, graph pools and kernel temporaries require separate headroom.
+The native dummy key-scale workspace is reserved separately in pool sizing.

+Selection semantics and accuracy status
+--------------------------------------
+For an offloaded request (page-aligned prefix >= C), select K from the stable
+prefix and attend all currently visible tail tokens as well. The Q1 adapter
+has at most one visible 128-token tail page. Short requests use the non-offload
+route. IndexShare consumers reuse the anchor plan with their own layer KV.
+
+This differs from the original full-sequence TopK policy. Equal results against
+the same-policy LI reference do not establish model-quality parity against
+full-sequence TopK. C controls resident capacity rather than K. Once both
+configurations are in the offload route, misses are fetched rather than
+dropped. The experimental route threshold is page-aligned prefix >= C:
+changing C can therefore change the selection policy near that threshold.
+Cross-C quality equivalence is not claimed for these transition lengths.
+Incorrect cache routing would still be a correctness bug, hence the bitwise
+KV checks.
+
+Covered on real NPU: TopK set parity on fixed fixtures with wide score margins,
+bitwise selected KV parity, SFA output tolerance rtol=0.01/atol=0.002, cold fill,
+short requests, request allocation/reset/reuse, indexer entry, new-token D2H,
+IndexShare payloads, graph capture/replay, and post-timing payload checks.
+Dynamic graph coverage crosses seq_len 8193 -> 8321, forces the newly visible
+page into TopK, then exercises mixed padding and request reuse. Invalid source
+IDs are masked explicitly because the native invalid-row path can retain stale
+outputs during graph replay.

+# Native LIM and CopySFA validation
+
+With `SGLANG_NPU_ENABLE_SPARSE_KV_OFFLOAD=1`, set
+`SGLANG_NPU_ENABLE_FUSED_LIM_COPYSFA=1` to use native LIM and combined-cache
+CopySFA for target decode and target verify. The default value `0` selects the
+original four-stream offload implementation. The draft model keeps its
+independent native HBM KV pool. Ordinary prefill retains vendor SFA.
+
+The indexer selector, CopySFA enable flag, full-visible MTP enable flag, and
+pre/post metadata enable flags have been removed. The fused path does not use
+legacy decode dispatch, per-query attention loops, or host callbacks.
+
+## Geometry and residency
+
+The maximum query width is derived from `speculative_num_draft_tokens` (one
+without speculation). Each forward uses its actual `spec_info.num_tokens_per_req`;
+ordinary decode uses one query. The native LIM limit is 14 queries per request.
+The matching kernel wheel exposes `lim_full_visible_max_query_width()` so an
+incompatible wheel fails before capture.
+
+`SGLANG_NPU_SPARSE_KV_CACHE_SIZE=0` selects `max_query_width * 2048` resident
+slots. Explicit C must cover that union, be page aligned, and be at most 32640.
+`SGLANG_NPU_SPARSE_KV_HBM_BUDGET_MB` caps persistent manager allocations.
+A3 uses full-visible selection; the separate HBM-tail experiment is not enabled.
+
+In full-visible mode, L is the last actual query position plus one.
+For L < C, CopySFA receives `num_cache_tokens=0`, the actual L, and the row's
+real HBM page table. It attends all visible KV, including when K < L < C.
+For L >= C, it consumes native LIM's resident TopK plan. This threshold is per
+request on device; a short neighbor never changes the batch's graph admission.
+
+New KV is published to paged host storage and the short row's continuous HBM
+range. Per-layer valid extents prevent repeated history copies. Missing history
+is restored through the allocator's physical token mapping, including radix
+prefix hits. Request reuse invalidates the extents; rollback from sparse to
+dense rehydrates the missing dense range. Long full-visible rows retain the
+resident-refresh CopySFA optimization.
+
+## Component checks
+
+Initialize Ascend/ATB and select the matching framework and kernel packages,
+then run from the framework repository root:
+
+```bash
+python3 -m pytest -q \
+  test/manual/npu/test_lim_short_dynamic.py \
+  test/manual/npu/test_fused_host_kv.py \
+  test/manual/npu/test_lim_mtp_copy_metadata.py \
+  test/manual/npu/test_lim_pre_metadata_graph.py \
+  test/manual/npu/test_lim_mtp_manager.py
+```
+
+The mixed-row fixture checks FP32 attention, both KV layers, request/TP padding,
+L=1, page/K/C boundaries, sparse-to-dense rollback, radix-prefix attachment,
+ragged chunk prefill and exact persistent HBM accounting. Graph capture starts
+with all padding and then replays cold real requests.
+The separate prefill test checks vendor SFA against FP32 attention after
+page-permuted prefix reuse and checks continuous HBM KV bitwise.
+
+```bash
+python3 benchmark/hisparse/bench_lim_framework.py \
+  --widths 1,4 --graph both --timing --output /tmp/native-lim.json
+```
+
+Timing covers one indexer owner and two layer consumers, including current-KV
+publication, residency maintenance, CopySFA and output clones. It uses fixed
+resident inputs; it excludes model projections, scheduler and sampling.
+The `check_lim_*` and `bench_lim_copy_sfa.py` entry points use this same fixture.
+Historical measurements in this directory remain tied to their recorded SHAs.
+
+## Original vLLM operator comparison
+
+Build/install the original CopySFA OPP from the chosen vLLM Ascend revision and
+source its private vendor `set_env.bash`. Keep its operator sources unchanged.
+The helper binds the original Torch adapter rather than replacing its device
+implementation:
+
+```bash
+python3 benchmark/hisparse/build_copy_sfa_reference.py \
+  --vllm-csrc /path/to/vllm-ascend/csrc --build-dir /tmp/vllm-copy-reference
+python3 benchmark/hisparse/compare_copy_sfa_short_reference.py \
+  --reference-library /tmp/vllm-copy-reference/vllm_copy_reference.so \
+  --reference-commit 4f3648abd258a5cbdd1a9ae34165a85f5e44beaf \
+  --output /tmp/copy-short-reference.json
+```
+
+Both operators consume the same frozen query/KV/page tensors, with an
+independent FP32 oracle. The comparison covers C=0 short-row attention only;
+it does not establish equivalence of the long-row full-visible and vLLM
+prefix/tail policies. Graph timings unroll ten operator calls and exclude LIM,
+KV publication and residency staging. Hardware acceptance is separate: A3
+results do not establish A5 execution or whole-model accuracy.
+
+## Rebased validation status
+
+The current integration preserves the existing four-stream implementation in
+`manager.py` and `attention.py`. Fused execution uses `fused_manager.py`,
+`fused_attention.py`, and `fused_lim.py`. The paired kernel is PR #909 at
+`e82667615fb69eea3d918dbd8a2a6dda81f6a2d7`. Runtime validation of this rebased
+framework commit is pending; earlier A3 results belong to their recorded source
+versions. A5 runtime validation is also pending.

+"""CPU-only HBM/H2D scenario accounting and replay of recorded TopK traces.
+
+This is an analytical tool, not a model latency benchmark. Example:
+  python benchmark/hisparse/analyze_budget.py --output analysis/scenarios.json
+  python benchmark/hisparse/analyze_budget.py --trace topk.jsonl --output replay.json
+
+Trace rows: {"request_id": "r1", "generation": 0, "layer": 0,
+             "step": 0, "token_ids": [1, 2, 3]}
+Use one row per request/layer/decode step in execution order. MTP query unions
+must be prepared separately; this tool does not simulate speculative rollback.
+"""
+
+import argparse
+import importlib.util
+import json
+import sys
+from collections import OrderedDict
+from dataclasses import asdict
+from pathlib import Path
+
+
+def load_budget_module():
+    path = (
+        Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+        / "python/sglang/srt/hardware_backend/npu/sparsity_driven_kv_offload/budget.py"
+    )
+    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("hisparse_budget_analysis", path)
+    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+    sys.modules[spec.name] = module
+    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
+    return module
+
+
+def replay_trace(path, capacities, kv_bytes_per_token, warmup_steps=0):
+    caches = {capacity: {} for capacity in capacities}
+    results = {
+        capacity: dict(hits=0, misses=0, counted_rows=0) for capacity in capacities
+    }
+    last_steps, row_counts = {}, {}
+    with Path(path).open(encoding="utf-8") as trace:
+        for line_number, line in enumerate(trace, 1):
+            if not line.strip():
+                continue
+            row = json.loads(line)
+            key = (str(row["request_id"]), row.get("generation", 0), row["layer"])
+            step = row["step"]
+            if key in last_steps and step <= last_steps[key]:
+                raise ValueError(
+                    f"Trace row {line_number}: steps must increase for each request/generation/layer."
+                )
+            last_steps[key] = step
+            count = row_counts.get(key, 0)
+            row_counts[key] = count + 1
+            tokens = list(
+                dict.fromkeys(token for token in row["token_ids"] if token >= 0)
+            )
+            for capacity in capacities:
+                if len(tokens) > capacity:
+                    raise ValueError(
+                        f"Trace row {line_number}: {len(tokens)} selected tokens exceed capacity {capacity}."
+                    )
+                cache = caches[capacity].setdefault(key, OrderedDict())
+                hits = set(tokens).intersection(cache)
+                misses = [token for token in tokens if token not in hits]
+                # Match the tensor planner's round-level recency: retain hits
+                # in their old order, then make misses the newest entries.
+                for token in list(cache):
+                    if token in hits:
+                        cache.move_to_end(token)
+                for token in misses:
+                    if len(cache) == capacity:
+                        cache.popitem(last=False)
+                    cache[token] = None
+                if count >= warmup_steps:
+                    results[capacity]["hits"] += len(hits)
+                    results[capacity]["misses"] += len(misses)
+                    results[capacity]["counted_rows"] += 1
+    output = []
+    for capacity, result in results.items():
+        total = result["hits"] + result["misses"]
+        output.append(
+            dict(
+                cache_tokens=capacity,
+                **result,
+                hit_rate=result["hits"] / total if total else None,
+                h2d_kv_bytes=result["misses"] * kv_bytes_per_token,
+            )
+        )
+    return output
+
+
+def scenario_grid(args):
+    budget = load_budget_module()
+    rows = []
+    for input_len in args.input_lens:
+        for output_len in args.output_lens:
+            context_len = input_len + output_len
+            for batch_size in args.batch_sizes:
+                for capacity in args.cache_sizes:
+                    allocation = budget.resolve_sparse_kv_budget(
+                        request_rows=batch_size + 1,
+                        context_len=context_len,
+                        num_layers=args.layers,
+                        top_k=args.top_k,
+                        kv_bytes_per_token=args.kv_bytes,
+                        cache_tokens=capacity,
+                    )
+                    indexer_bytes = (
+                        (batch_size + 1) * context_len * args.layers * args.index_bytes
+                    )
+                    for hit_rate in args.hit_rates:
+                        h2d_bytes_per_layer = (
+                            batch_size
+                            * min(args.top_k, context_len)
+                            * (1 - hit_rate)
+                            * args.kv_bytes
+                        )
+                        io_us_per_layer = (
+                            h2d_bytes_per_layer / (args.h2d_gbps * 1e9) * 1e6
+                        )
+                        rows.append(
+                            dict(
+                                input_len=input_len,
+                                output_len=output_len,
+                                context_len=context_len,
+                                batch_size=batch_size,
+                                assumed_hit_rate=hit_rate,
+                                allocation=asdict(allocation),
+                                managed_hbm_bytes=allocation.managed_hbm_bytes,
+                                indexer_hbm_bytes=indexer_bytes,
+                                dense_main_kv_bytes=(batch_size + 1)
+                                * context_len
+                                * args.layers
+                                * args.kv_bytes,
+                                h2d_bytes_per_layer=h2d_bytes_per_layer,
+                                ideal_h2d_us_per_layer=io_us_per_layer,
+                                optimistic_exposed_io_us_per_step=max(
+                                    0, io_us_per_layer - args.overlap_us
+                                )
+                                * args.layers,
+                            )
+                        )
+    return rows
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--input-lens", type=int, nargs="+", default=[8192, 32768, 131072]
+    )
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--output-lens", type=int, nargs="+", default=[1024, 8192, 32768]
+    )
+    parser.add_argument("--batch-sizes", type=int, nargs="+", default=[1, 16, 64])
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--cache-sizes", type=int, nargs="+", default=[2048, 4096, 8192]
+    )
+    parser.add_argument("--hit-rates", type=float, nargs="+", default=[0.5, 0.9, 0.99])
+    parser.add_argument("--top-k", type=int, default=2048)
+    parser.add_argument("--layers", type=int, default=61, help="KV layers on this rank")
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--kv-bytes",
+        type=int,
+        default=1152,
+        help="Actual CKV + RoPE row bytes per rank/layer",
+    )
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--index-bytes",
+        type=int,
+        default=256,
+        help="Indexer row bytes; 256 models a BF16 128D NPU indexer",
+    )
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--h2d-gbps",
+        type=float,
+        default=32,
+        help="Assumed effective per-rank DRAM link GB/s, decimal",
+    )
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--overlap-us",
+        type=float,
+        default=100,
+        help="Assumed independent compute window per layer; NOT measured",
+    )
+    parser.add_argument("--trace", type=Path)
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--warmup-steps",
+        type=int,
+        default=0,
+        help="Exclude initial rows per request/generation/layer from replay counts",
+    )
+    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    if (
+        min(
+            args.top_k,
+            args.layers,
+            args.kv_bytes,
+            args.h2d_gbps,
+            *args.cache_sizes,
+            *args.input_lens,
+            *args.output_lens,
+            *args.batch_sizes,
+        )
+        <= 0
+    ):
+        parser.error(
+            "Lengths, capacities, layers, KV bytes and bandwidth must be positive."
+        )
+    if (
+        args.warmup_steps < 0
+        or args.overlap_us < 0
+        or args.index_bytes < 0
+        or any(not 0 <= rate <= 1 for rate in args.hit_rates)
+    ):
+        parser.error(
+            "Warmup/overlap/index bytes must be nonnegative; hit rates must be in [0, 1]."
+        )
+    result = dict(
+        kind="topk_trace_replay" if args.trace else "analytical_scenarios",
+        notes="No device timings. Hit rates, bandwidth and overlap windows in scenarios are assumptions. Memory excludes weights, native indexer pool metadata, runtime temporaries and graph pools.",
+        rows=(
+            replay_trace(args.trace, args.cache_sizes, args.kv_bytes, args.warmup_steps)
+            if args.trace
+            else scenario_grid(args)
+        ),
+    )
+    encoded = json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n"
+    if args.output:
+        args.output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        args.output.write_text(encoded, encoding="utf-8")
+        print(f"Wrote {len(result['rows'])} rows to {args.output}")
+    else:
+        print(encoded, end="")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+"""Analyze raw CANN trace_view.json without treating cumulative time as wall time.
+
+Graph windows use repeated (model, physical stream, task id) anchors and are
+accepted only when each contains exactly 78 SFA calls. They include the captured
+model graph's other work (for example the LM head); they are not a measured
+78-layer-only wall time. Copy direction is source-order attribution for the
+current BF16 LIM adapter, accepted only for complete five-copy/SFA groups.
+"""
+
+import argparse
+import collections
+import hashlib
+import itertools
+import json
+import statistics
+from decimal import Decimal
+from pathlib import Path
+
+TASK_TYPES = {"AI_CORE", "AI_VECTOR_CORE", "AI_CPU", "MIX_AIC", "MIX_AIV"}
+COPY_MEANINGS = (
+    "new-token D2H",
+    "miss DRAM-to-resident H2D",
+    "resident-to-selected D2D",
+    "short-row H2D (masked on long rows)",
+    "visible-tail H2D",
+)
+
+
+def interval_union(intervals):
+    """Length of a union, including nested, touching and overlapping spans."""
+    result = 0.0
+    end = None
+    for left, right in sorted(intervals):
+        if right < left:
+            raise ValueError("Negative interval")
+        if end is None or left > end:
+            result += right - left
+        else:
+            result += max(0.0, right - end)
+        end = right if end is None else max(end, right)
+    return result
+
+
+def overlap_length(left, right):
+    """Intersection of two interval unions; duplicate tasks cannot inflate it."""
+    a = interval_union(left)
+    b = interval_union(right)
+    return max(0.0, a + b - interval_union(left + right))
+
+
+def normalize(name):
+    return name.lower().replace("_", "")
+
+
+def is_sfa(task):
+    return "sparseflashattention" in normalize(task["name"])
+
+
+def family(task):
+    name = normalize(task["name"])
+    if "lightningindexer" in name:
+        return "LIM" if "manage" in name else "LI"
+    if "unidexcopy" in name:
+        return "all_unidex_copies"
+    if "sparseflashattention" in name:
+        return "SFA"
+    if "hccl" in name or (
+        task["type"] == "AI_CPU"
+        and any(
+            pattern in name
+            for pattern in (
+                "allgatheraicpukernel",
+                "reducescatteraicpukernel",
+                "allreduceaicpukernel",
+            )
+        )
+    ):
+        return "HCCL_task_spans_including_waits"
+    return "other_tasks"
+
+
+def spans(tasks):
+    return [(r["start"], r["end"]) for r in tasks]
+
+
+def component_summary(tasks):
+    groups = collections.defaultdict(list)
+    for task in tasks:
+        groups[family(task)].append(task)
+    return {
+        key: {
+            "calls": len(rows),
+            "cumulative_ms": sum(r["dur"] for r in rows) / 1000,
+            "interval_union_ms": interval_union(spans(rows)) / 1000,
+        }
+        for key, rows in groups.items()
+    }
+
+
+def graph_windows(tasks, expected_layers):
+    models = collections.defaultdict(list)
+    for task in tasks:
+        if task["model"] not in (None, 4294967295, "4294967295"):
+            models[task["model"]].append(task)
+    reports = []
+    for model, rows in models.items():
+        # AIC/AIV graph task ids repeat at replay. AI_CPU communication has
+        # separate stream numbering and may contain long waits.
+        core = [r for r in rows if r["type"] != "AI_CPU"]
+        by_stream = collections.Counter(r["stream"] for r in core)
+        if not by_stream:
+            continue
+        stream = by_stream.most_common(1)[0][0]
+        selected = [
+            r for r in core if r["stream"] == stream and r["task_id"] is not None
+        ]
+        if not selected:
+            continue
+        first_id = min(r["task_id"] for r in selected)
+        anchors = [r for r in selected if r["task_id"] == first_id]
+        windows = []
+        for index, anchor in enumerate(anchors):
+            boundary = (
+                anchors[index + 1]["start"]
+                if index + 1 < len(anchors)
+                else float("inf")
+            )
+            chunk = [r for r in rows if anchor["start"] <= r["start"] < boundary]
+            sfa_count = sum(is_sfa(r) for r in chunk)
+            if sfa_count != expected_layers:
+                windows.append({"accepted": False, "sfa_calls": sfa_count})
+                continue
+            finish = max(r["end"] for r in chunk)
+            selected = [
+                r
+                for r in chunk
+                if family(r) in {"LI", "LIM", "all_unidex_copies", "SFA"}
+            ]
+            selected_union = interval_union(spans(selected))
+            windows.append(
+                {
+                    "accepted": True,
+                    "start_relative_us": anchor["start"],
+                    "exclusive_next_anchor_relative_us": (
+                        None if boundary == float("inf") else boundary
+                    ),
+                    "end_relative_us": finish,
+                    "device_graph_span_ms": (finish - anchor["start"]) / 1000,
+                    "next_anchor_gap_ms": (
+                        None
+                        if boundary == float("inf")
+                        else (boundary - anchor["start"]) / 1000
+                    ),
+                    "task_interval_union_ms": interval_union(spans(chunk)) / 1000,
+                    "selected_components_interval_union_ms": selected_union / 1000,
+                    "wall_outside_selected_components_ms": (
+                        finish - anchor["start"] - selected_union
+                    )
+                    / 1000,
+                    "sfa_calls": sfa_count,
+                    "components": component_summary(chunk),
+                }
+            )
+        reports.append(
+            {
+                "model_id": model,
+                "anchor_stream": stream,
+                "anchor_task_id": first_id,
+                "windows": windows,
+            }
+        )
+    return reports
+
+
+def analyze(path, expected_layers=78):
+    raw = path.read_bytes()
+    payload = json.loads(raw)
+    events = payload.get("traceEvents", []) if isinstance(payload, dict) else payload
+    candidates = [
+        r
+        for r in events
+        if r.get("ph") == "X"
+        and r.get("args", {}).get("Task Type") in TASK_TYPES
+        and "dur" in r
+    ]
+    if not candidates:
+        raise ValueError("No explicit CANN task events")
+    origin = min(Decimal(str(r["ts"])) for r in candidates)
+    tasks = []
+    for row in candidates:
+        info = row["args"]
+        start = float(Decimal(str(row["ts"])) - origin)
+        duration = float(row["dur"])
+        tasks.append(
+            {
+                "name": row["name"],
+                "start": start,
+                "end": start + duration,
+                "dur": duration,
+                "stream": info.get("Physic Stream Id"),
+                "type": info["Task Type"],
+                "model": info.get("Model Id"),
+                "task_id": info.get("Task Id"),
+            }
+        )
+    tasks.sort(key=lambda r: r["start"])
+    all_tasks = tasks
+    graph = graph_windows(all_tasks, expected_layers)
+    accepted = [w for model in graph for w in model["windows"] if w["accepted"]]
+    if accepted:
+        ranges = [
+            (
+                model["model_id"],
+                window["start_relative_us"],
+                window["exclusive_next_anchor_relative_us"],
+            )
+            for model in graph
+            for window in model["windows"]
+            if window["accepted"]
+        ]
+        # Asynchronous start/stop can record the tail of a preceding replay.
+        # Keep complete model replays for every kernel/copy total, not just
+        # for graph wall spans. Retain untrimmed counts for auditability.
+        tasks = [
+            task
+            for task in all_tasks
+            if any(
+                task["model"] == model
+                and task["start"] >= start
+                and (end is None or task["start"] < end)
+                for model, start, end in ranges
+            )
+        ]
+    total = sum(r["dur"] for r in tasks)
+    by_name = collections.defaultdict(list)
+    for row in tasks:
+        by_name[row["name"]].append(row)
+    kernel = []
+    for name, rows in by_name.items():
+        duration = sum(r["dur"] for r in rows)
+        share = 100 * duration / total
+        if share >= 1:
+            kernel.append(
+                {
+                    "name": name,
+                    "calls": len(rows),
+                    "cumulative_ms": duration / 1000,
+                    "cumulative_share_percent": share,
+                    "interval_union_ms": interval_union(spans(rows)) / 1000,
+                    "streams": sorted({r["stream"] for r in rows}, key=str),
+                }
+            )
+    kernel.sort(key=lambda r: r["cumulative_ms"], reverse=True)
+    pending, groups, ambiguous = [], [], []
+    for row in tasks:
+        if family(row) == "all_unidex_copies":

+    positions = []
+    for index, meaning in enumerate(COPY_MEANINGS):
+        values = [g[index]["dur"] for g, _ in groups]
+        positions.append(
+            {

+        "cpu_step_annotation_counts": dict(

+        "trailing_unassigned_copies": len(pending),

+"""Run native LIM+CopySFA mixed-row accuracy and optional subpath timings.
+
+The fixture covers K/C/page boundaries, graph replay, ragged prefill, rollback,
+radix-prefix reuse, request padding and an independent TP padding suffix.
+Historical reference/legacy comparisons require their recorded source revision.
+"""
+
+import argparse
+import hashlib
+import importlib.util
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import torch
+import torch_npu
+
+
+def main(default_widths="1,2,3,4,5,8,14", default_timing=False):
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument("--widths", default=default_widths)
+    parser.add_argument("--capacity", type=int, help="C; defaults to at least Q*2048")
+    parser.add_argument("--graph", choices=("on", "off", "both"), default="both")
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--timing", action=argparse.BooleanOptionalAction, default=default_timing
+    )
+    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    torch.set_num_threads(2)
+    fixture_path = (
+        Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+        / "test/manual/npu/test_lim_short_dynamic.py"
+    )
+    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("native_lim_fixture", fixture_path)
+    fixture = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+    spec.loader.exec_module(fixture)
+    records = []
+    args.output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    for graph in (False, True) if args.graph == "both" else (args.graph == "on",):
+        for width in map(int, args.widths.split(",")):
+            capacity = args.capacity or max(8192, (width * 2048 + 4095) // 4096 * 4096)
+            if not 1 <= width <= 14 or capacity < width * 2048:
+                parser.error("native query width must be 1..14 and C must cover Q*2048")
+            record = {"width": width, "capacity": capacity, "graph": graph}
+            fixture.test_short_sparse_graph_lifecycle(
+                width, capacity, graph, record.__setitem__, measure=args.timing
+            )
+            record["accuracy"] = "pass"
+            records.append(record)
+            result = dict(
+                scope="fixed-projection manager subpath; excludes model weights, scheduler and sampling",
+                fixture_sha256=hashlib.sha256(fixture_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
+                torch=torch.__version__,
+                torch_npu=torch_npu.__version__,
+                cases=records,
+            )
+            args.output.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + "\n")
+            print(json.dumps(record), flush=True)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+"""Checkpoint-backed smoke, repeatability and serving performance client.
+
+Generate identical token-ID fixtures once, then point the same client at each
+server mode. Use a mode/configuration-specific --tag to retain raw results.
+The generated needle checks are smoke coverage, not a general quality metric.
+Performance includes serving/scheduling/prefill; profiling runs stay separate."""
+
+import argparse
+import concurrent.futures
+import hashlib
+import json
+import pathlib
+import statistics
+import time
+import urllib.request
+
+ROOT = pathlib.Path.cwd()
+MODEL_PATH = None
+BASE = "http://127.0.0.1:30000"
+
+
+def prepare():
+    from transformers import AutoTokenizer
+
+    tok = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(MODEL_PATH, trust_remote_code=True)
+    rows = []
+    for length in (512, 8192, 32768):
+        for variant in range(4):
+            needle = f"仓库 ZX-{variant + 17} 的校验码为 LIM{7319 + variant * 113}。"
+            lines = "".join(
+                f"记录{i}: 普通物料批次，数量{(i * 73 + variant * 19) % 997}，日期2026年10月。\n"
+                for i in range(5000)
+            )
+            start = tok.encode(
+                "以下是仓库清单。请阅读全部记录。\n", add_special_tokens=False
+            )
+            middle = tok.encode(lines, add_special_tokens=False)
+            fact = tok.encode(
+                "\n唯一关键记录：" + needle + "\n", add_special_tokens=False
+            )
+            suffix = f"\n根据上文，仓库 ZX-{variant + 17} 的校验码是什么？只输出校验码，不要解释。"
+            # Keep the exact target token count and the original chat template.
+            base_messages = [{"role": "user", "content": "PLACEHOLDER" + suffix}]
+            template = tok.apply_chat_template(
+                base_messages,
+                tokenize=False,
+                add_generation_prompt=True,
+                enable_thinking=False,
+            )
+            before, after = template.split("PLACEHOLDER", 1)
+            a, z = (
+                tok.encode(before, add_special_tokens=False),
+                tok.encode(after, add_special_tokens=False),
+            )
+            room = length - len(a) - len(z) - len(start) - len(fact)
+            assert room > 0
+            split = room // 2
+            body = start + middle[:split] + fact + middle[split:room]
+            ids = a + body + z
+            assert len(ids) == length, (len(ids), length)
+            rows.append(
+                {
+                    "name": f"L{length}-v{variant}",
+                    "input_ids": ids,
+                    "expected": f"LIM{7319 + variant * 113}",
+                    "sha256": hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(ids).encode()).hexdigest(),
+                }
+            )
+    (ROOT / "results/prompts.json").write_text(json.dumps(rows, ensure_ascii=False))
+    print(
+        json.dumps(
+            [{k: v for k, v in row.items() if k != "input_ids"} for row in rows],
+            ensure_ascii=False,
+        ),
+        flush=True,
+    )
+
+
+def request(row, output, logprobs=False, ignore_eos=False, stop=None):
+    started_unix = time.time()
+    body = {
+        "input_ids": row["input_ids"],
+        "stream": True,
+        "sampling_params": {
+            "temperature": 0,
+            "max_new_tokens": output,
+            "ignore_eos": ignore_eos,
+        },
+        "return_logprob": logprobs,
+        "logprob_start_len": -1,
+    }
+    if logprobs:
+        body["top_logprobs_num"] = 5
+    if stop:
+        body["sampling_params"]["stop"] = stop
+    req = urllib.request.Request(
+        BASE + "/generate",
+        data=json.dumps(body).encode(),
+        headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"},
+    )
+    t0 = time.perf_counter()
+    times, counts, final = [], [], None
+    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=1800) as response:
+        for raw in response:
+            if not raw.startswith(b"data: "):
+                continue
+            value = raw[6:].strip()
+            if value == b"[DONE]":
+                break
+            data = json.loads(value)
+            if "error" in data:
+                raise RuntimeError(data)
+            final = data
+            count = data.get("meta_info", {}).get("completion_tokens", 0)
+            if not counts or count > counts[-1]:
+                times.append(time.perf_counter() - t0)
+                counts.append(count)
+    elapsed = time.perf_counter() - t0
+    if final is None:
+        raise RuntimeError("Server returned no generation payload")
+    n = final.get("meta_info", {}).get("completion_tokens", 0)
+    if ignore_eos and n != output:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"Expected {output} completion tokens, got {n}.")
+    return {
+        "case": row["name"],
+        "input_length": len(row["input_ids"]),
+        "prompt_sha256": row["sha256"],
+        "requested_output": output,
+        "started_unix": started_unix,
+        "finished_unix": time.time(),
+        "actual_output": n,
+        "elapsed_s": elapsed,
+        "ttft_s": times[0] if times else None,
+        "tpot_s": (times[-1] - times[0]) / (counts[-1] - counts[0])
+        if len(times) > 1 and counts[-1] > counts[0]
+        else None,
+        "arrival_s": times,
+        "completion_counts": counts,
+        "expected": row["expected"],
+        "answer_contains_expected": row["expected"] in final.get("text", ""),
+        "response": final,
+    }
+
+
+def run(args):
+    rows = json.loads((ROOT / "results/prompts.json").read_text())
+    out = ROOT / "results" / f"{args.tag}-{args.phase}.jsonl"
+    selected = [
+        r for r in rows if (args.length == 0 or len(r["input_ids"]) == args.length)
+    ]
+    if not selected:
+        raise ValueError("No prepared prompts match --length.")
+    if args.phase == "smoke":
+        selected = [r for r in selected if r["name"] in ("L512-v0", "L8192-v0")]
+        for row in selected:
+            result = request(row, 64, logprobs=True)
+            with out.open("a") as file:
+                file.write(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
+            print(
+                json.dumps(
+                    {
+                        k: v
+                        for k, v in result.items()
+                        if k not in ("response", "arrival_s", "completion_counts")
+                    },
+                    ensure_ascii=False,
+                ),
+                flush=True,
+            )
+            print(result["response"].get("text", "")[:800], flush=True)
+    elif args.phase == "correctness":
+        for repeat in range(2):
+            for row in selected:
+                result = request(row, args.output, logprobs=True)
+                result["repeat"] = repeat
+                with out.open("a") as file:
+                    file.write(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
+                print(
+                    row["name"],
+                    repeat,
+                    result["actual_output"],
+                    result["answer_contains_expected"],
+                    flush=True,
+                )
+    elif args.phase == "perf":
+        group = selected[: args.concurrency]
+        assert len(group) == args.concurrency
+        for repeat in range(args.rounds + 1):
+            t0 = time.perf_counter()
+            with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(
+                max_workers=args.concurrency
+            ) as pool:
+                result = list(
+                    pool.map(
+                        lambda row: request(row, args.output, ignore_eos=True), group
+                    )
+                )
+            elapsed = time.perf_counter() - t0
+            record = {
+                "repeat": repeat,
+                "warmup": repeat == 0,
+                "concurrency": args.concurrency,
+                "wall_s": elapsed,
+                "output_tokens_per_s": sum(r["actual_output"] for r in result)
+                / elapsed,
+                "median_tpot_s": statistics.median(r["tpot_s"] for r in result),
+                "median_ttft_s": statistics.median(r["ttft_s"] for r in result),
+                "requests": result,
+            }
+            with out.open("a") as file:
+                file.write(json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
+            print(
+                json.dumps({k: v for k, v in record.items() if k != "requests"}),
+                flush=True,
+            )
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    p = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    p.add_argument(
+        "--phase", choices=["prepare", "smoke", "correctness", "perf"], required=True
+    )
+    p.add_argument("--tag", default="lim-c4096")
+    p.add_argument("--length", type=int, default=8192)
+    p.add_argument("--output", type=int, default=128)
+    p.add_argument("--concurrency", type=int, default=1)
+    p.add_argument("--rounds", type=int, default=3)
+    p.add_argument("--workdir", type=pathlib.Path, default=pathlib.Path.cwd())
+    p.add_argument("--model-path", help="Local tokenizer path, required for prepare.")
+    p.add_argument("--base-url", default="http://127.0.0.1:30000")
+    args = p.parse_args()
+    if args.rounds < 1 or args.output < 2 or not 1 <= args.concurrency <= 4:
+        p.error("Require rounds >= 1, output >= 2, and concurrency in [1,4].")
+    ROOT, MODEL_PATH, BASE = args.workdir, args.model_path, args.base_url.rstrip("/")
+    (ROOT / "results").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    if args.phase == "prepare" and MODEL_PATH is None:
+        p.error("--model-path is required for --phase prepare")
+    prepare() if args.phase == "prepare" else run(args)

+"""Diagnostic-only fixed-history decode logits; never use these requests for timing.
+
+The custom processor saves untouched model logits before forcing the reference
+token. API logprobs after forcing are deliberately ignored. Full-vocabulary KL
+is computed in float64 on CPU; identical token histories are checked explicitly.
+
+Run this client in the server's filesystem namespace with a shared absolute
+--workdir and --enable-custom-logit-processor on the server. Each capture tag
+stores full logits, verified HTTP results and frozen token-ID fixtures. At
+vocab=154880, 32 samples x 512 positions require about 10 GB per capture tag.
+Use a fresh tag for every capture; keep these diagnostics outside timed runs.
+For fixed chunked prefill, pass --prefill-chunk-size and use concurrency one.
+The helper validates that radix reuse and dynamic chunking are disabled, skips
+discarded intermediate-chunk sampling calls, and verifies the final token history.
+"""
+
+import argparse
+import concurrent.futures
+import hashlib
+import json
+import math
+import time
+import urllib.request
+from pathlib import Path
+
+
+def processor_string():
+    from sglang.srt.sampling.custom_logit_processor import CustomLogitProcessor
+
+    class CaptureAndForce(CustomLogitProcessor):
+        def __call__(self, logits, custom_param_list):
+            import json
+            from pathlib import Path
+
+            import torch
+
+            for row, params in enumerate(custom_param_list):
+                # Processor instances can be rebuilt at batch merges and at the
+                # prefill/decode boundary. Request custom_params outlive them.
+                call = params.get("_lim_precision_call", 0)
+                params["_lim_precision_call"] = call + 1
+                skip = params.get("prefill_sampling_calls_to_skip", 0)
+                if call < skip:
+                    continue
+                step = call - skip
+                forced = params.get("force_ids")
+                if forced is not None and step >= len(forced):
+                    raise RuntimeError("Teacher continuation exhausted")
+                if torch.distributed.get_rank() == 0:
+                    target = (
+                        Path(params["capture_root"]) / params["tag"] / params["case"]
+                    )
+                    target.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+                    raw = logits[row].detach().float().cpu()
+                    if not torch.isfinite(raw).all():
+                        raise RuntimeError("Nonfinite untouched model logits")
+                    token = int(raw.argmax()) if forced is None else forced[step]
+                    torch.save(raw, target / f"{step:04d}.pt")
+                    with (target / "steps.jsonl").open("a", encoding="utf-8") as file:
+                        file.write(
+                            json.dumps(
+                                {
+                                    "step": step,
+                                    "raw_sampling_call": call,
+                                    "prefill_sampling_calls_skipped": skip,
+                                    "forced_token": token,
+                                    "raw_argmax": int(raw.argmax()),
+                                    "active_processor_rows": logits.shape[0],
+                                    "vocab_size": raw.numel(),
+                                }
+                            )
+                            + "\n"
+                        )
+                if forced is not None:
+                    logits[row].fill_(-float("inf"))
+                    logits[row, forced[step]] = 0
+            return logits
+
+    return CaptureAndForce.to_str()
+
+
+def request(args, processor, row):
+    forced = row.get("force_ids")
+    payload = {
+        "input_ids": row["input_ids"],
+        "stream": False,
+        "custom_logit_processor": processor,
+        "sampling_params": {
+            "temperature": 0,
+            "max_new_tokens": args.tokens,
+            "ignore_eos": True,
+            "custom_params": {
+                "request_key": args.tag + ":" + row["name"],
+                "tag": args.tag,
+                "case": row["name"],
+                "capture_root": str(args.workdir / "results/teacher-logits"),
+                "force_ids": forced,
+                "prefill_sampling_calls_to_skip": partial_prefill_sample_count(
+                    len(row["input_ids"]), args.prefill_chunk_size
+                ),
+            },
+        },
+        "return_logprob": True,
+        "logprob_start_len": -1,
+        "return_text_in_logprobs": False,
+    }
+    started = time.time()
+    req = urllib.request.Request(
+        args.base_url.rstrip("/") + "/generate",
+        data=json.dumps(payload).encode(),
+        headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"},
+    )
+    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=3600) as response:
+        result = json.load(response)
+    response_root = args.workdir / "results/teacher-http" / args.tag
+    response_root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    (response_root / f"{row['name']}.json").write_text(
+        json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False), encoding="utf-8"
+    )
+    if "error" in result:
+        raise RuntimeError(result)
+    observed = [int(item[1]) for item in result["meta_info"]["output_token_logprobs"]]
+    if len(observed) != args.tokens:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"Incomplete continuation: {row['name']} {len(observed)}")
+    if forced is not None and observed != forced:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"Teacher history differs: {row['name']}")
+    directory = args.workdir / "results/teacher-logits" / args.tag / row["name"]
+    steps = [
+        json.loads(line)
+        for line in (directory / "steps.jsonl").read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()
+    ]
+    if [r["step"] for r in steps] != list(range(args.tokens)):
+        raise RuntimeError(f"Invalid processor step sequence: {row['name']}")
+    expected_skip = partial_prefill_sample_count(
+        len(row["input_ids"]), args.prefill_chunk_size
+    )
+    if [r["raw_sampling_call"] for r in steps] != list(
+        range(expected_skip, expected_skip + args.tokens)
+    ):
+        raise RuntimeError(f"Chunked sampling calls differ: {row['name']}")
+    if [r["forced_token"] for r in steps] != observed:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"Capture/sampler token mismatch: {row['name']}")
+    return {
+        "name": row["name"],
+        "input_ids": row["input_ids"],
+        "force_ids": observed,
+        "input_sha256": hashlib.sha256(
+            json.dumps(row["input_ids"]).encode()
+        ).hexdigest(),
+        "started_unix": started,
+        "finished_unix": time.time(),
+        "response": result,
+    }
+
+
+def partial_prefill_sample_count(input_length, chunk_size):
+    return (
+        max(0, (input_length + chunk_size - 1) // chunk_size - 1)
+        if chunk_size > 0
+        else 0
+    )
+
+
+def validate_prefill_settings(base_url, chunk_size, concurrency):
+    with urllib.request.urlopen(
+        base_url.rstrip("/") + "/server_info", timeout=120
+    ) as response:
+        info = json.load(response)
+    settings = info.get("server_args", info)
+    configured = settings.get("chunked_prefill_size")
+    expected = chunk_size if chunk_size > 0 else -1
+    if configured != expected and not (expected == -1 and configured is None):
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            f"Pass the server's fixed prefill chunk size explicitly: server={configured}, requested={expected}"
+        )
+    if chunk_size > 0 and (
+        concurrency != 1
+        or not settings.get("disable_radix_cache")
+        or settings.get("enable_dynamic_chunking")
+        or settings.get("enable_mixed_chunk")
+    ):
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            "Chunked logits capture requires real concurrency 1, disabled radix cache, fixed chunks and no mixed chunks"
+        )
+    return settings
+
+
+def capture(args):
+    validate_prefill_settings(args.base_url, args.prefill_chunk_size, args.concurrency)
+    source = json.loads(args.fixtures.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+    if len(source) < args.samples:
+        raise RuntimeError("Insufficient precision fixtures")
+    rows = source[: args.samples]
+    if args.force and any(len(r.get("force_ids", [])) != args.tokens for r in rows):
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            "Every teacher fixture must have the exact continuation length"
+        )
+    if not args.force:
+        rows = [{k: v for k, v in row.items() if k != "force_ids"} for row in rows]
+    root = args.workdir / "results"
+    if (root / "teacher-logits" / args.tag).exists():
+        raise RuntimeError("Capture tag already exists; choose a fresh tag")
+    processor = processor_string()
+    output = root / f"{args.tag}-teacher-requests.jsonl"
+    results = []
+    with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=args.concurrency) as pool:
+        for result in pool.map(lambda row: request(args, processor, row), rows):
+            results.append(result)
+            with output.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as file:
+                file.write(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
+            print(
+                json.dumps(
+                    {
+                        "case": result["name"],
+                        "tokens": len(result["force_ids"]),
+                        "history_verified": True,
+                    }
+                ),
+                flush=True,
+            )
+    fixtures = [
+        {
+            k: v
+            for k, v in r.items()
+            if k in ("name", "input_ids", "force_ids", "input_sha256")
+        }
+        for r in results
+    ]
+    (root / f"{args.tag}-teacher-fixtures.json").write_text(
+        json.dumps(fixtures), encoding="utf-8"
+    )
+    (root / f"{args.tag}-capture-status.json").write_text(
+        json.dumps(
+            {
+                "status": "verified",
+                "samples": len(results),
+                "tokens_per_sample": args.tokens,
+                "prefill_chunk_size": args.prefill_chunk_size,
+                "fixed_prefill_configuration_verified": True,
+                "source_sha256": hashlib.sha256(
+                    Path(__file__).read_bytes()
+                ).hexdigest(),
+                "fixed_histories_sha256": hashlib.sha256(
+                    json.dumps(fixtures, sort_keys=True).encode()
+                ).hexdigest(),
+            },
+            indent=2,
+        )
+        + "\n",
+        encoding="utf-8",
+    )
+
+
+def compare(args):
+    import torch
+
+    fixtures = json.loads(args.fixtures.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))[: args.samples]
+    root = args.workdir / "results/teacher-logits"
+    for tag in (args.reference, args.tag):
+        status = json.loads(
+            (args.workdir / "results" / f"{tag}-capture-status.json").read_text(
+                encoding="utf-8"
+            )
+        )
+        if (
+            status["status"] != "verified"
+            or status["samples"] < args.samples
+            or status["tokens_per_sample"] != args.tokens
+        ):
+            raise RuntimeError("Comparison requires a complete, verified capture")
+        observed = json.loads(
+            (args.workdir / "results" / f"{tag}-teacher-fixtures.json").read_text(
+                encoding="utf-8"
+            )
+        )
+        by_name = {row["name"]: row for row in observed}
+        for row in fixtures:
+            recorded = by_name[row["name"]]
+            if (
+                recorded["input_ids"] != row["input_ids"]
+                or recorded["force_ids"] != row["force_ids"]
+            ):
+                raise RuntimeError("Cannot compare logits on different token histories")
+    records = []
+    for row in fixtures:
+        for step in range(args.tokens):
+            reference = torch.load(
+                root / args.reference / row["name"] / f"{step:04d}.pt",
+                weights_only=True,
+            ).double()
+            candidate = torch.load(
+                root / args.tag / row["name"] / f"{step:04d}.pt", weights_only=True
+            ).double()
+            if (
+                reference.shape != candidate.shape
+                or not torch.isfinite(candidate).all()
+            ):
+                raise RuntimeError("Invalid candidate logits")
+            p_log, q_log = reference.log_softmax(-1), candidate.log_softmax(-1)
+            kl = float((p_log.exp() * (p_log - q_log)).sum())
+            token = row["force_ids"][step]
+            records.append(
+                {
+                    "case": row["name"],
+                    "step": step,
+                    "kl_reference_to_candidate": kl,
+                    "reference_token_logprob_abs_diff": float(
+                        (p_log[token] - q_log[token]).abs()
+                    ),
+                    "argmax_agrees": int(reference.argmax()) == int(candidate.argmax()),
+                    "logits_bitwise_equal": torch.equal(reference, candidate),
+                }
+            )
+    kls = sorted(r["kl_reference_to_candidate"] for r in records)
+    if not records or any(not math.isfinite(x) for x in kls):
+        raise RuntimeError("Empty or nonfinite precision comparison")
+    summary = {
+        "reference": args.reference,
+        "candidate": args.tag,
+        "samples": len(fixtures),
+        "tokens_per_sample": args.tokens,
+        "total_aligned_tokens": len(records),
+        "metric": "full-vocabulary KL(p_reference || p_candidate), float64 CPU",
+        "mean_kl": sum(kls) / len(kls),
+        "max_kl": max(kls),
+        "p99_kl": kls[min(len(kls) - 1, math.ceil(len(kls) * 0.99) - 1)],
+        "fraction_kl_above_1e_minus_3": sum(x > 1e-3 for x in kls) / len(kls),
+        "fraction_kl_above_1e_minus_2": sum(x > 1e-2 for x in kls) / len(kls),
+        "argmax_agreement": sum(r["argmax_agrees"] for r in records) / len(records),
+        "bitwise_equal_fraction": sum(r["logits_bitwise_equal"] for r in records)
+        / len(records),
+        "max_reference_token_logprob_abs_diff": max(
+            r["reference_token_logprob_abs_diff"] for r in records
+        ),
+        "limitations": "Diagnostic custom processor adds CPU synchronization and IO; not performance data. Cross-policy KL includes the policy change. Repeat each reference to measure same-mode variability.",
+    }
+    stem = args.workdir / "results" / f"{args.reference}-vs-{args.tag}-teacher"
+    stem.with_suffix(".json").write_text(
+        json.dumps(summary, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8"
+    )
+    stem.with_suffix(".jsonl").write_text(
+        "".join(json.dumps(r) + "\n" for r in records), encoding="utf-8"
+    )
+    print(json.dumps(summary, indent=2), flush=True)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument("phase", choices=("capture", "compare"))
+    parser.add_argument("--fixtures", type=Path, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--tag", required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--reference")
+    parser.add_argument("--force", action="store_true")
+    parser.add_argument("--samples", type=int, default=32)
+    parser.add_argument("--tokens", type=int, default=512)
+    parser.add_argument("--concurrency", type=int, default=4)
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--prefill-chunk-size",
+        type=int,
+        default=0,
+        help="Fixed server chunk size; 0 requires unchunked prefill",
+    )
+    parser.add_argument("--workdir", type=Path, default=Path.cwd())
+    parser.add_argument("--base-url", default="http://127.0.0.1:30000")
+    options = parser.parse_args()
+    if options.phase == "compare" and not options.reference:
+        parser.error("compare requires --reference")
+    capture(options) if options.phase == "capture" else compare(options)
